description: scan --fingerprint-index: a vendored directory whose version no header can state. Upstream cJSON.h writes its version as CJSON_VERSION_MAJOR, _MINOR and _PATCH, which the version-header heuristic reads (golden_nightmare-corpus reports pkg:generic/cjson@1.7.15 from them). This fixture's cJSON.h has those three macros removed on purpose, so without an index the heuristic falls back to the folder name, pkg:generic/cjson-prebuilt with no version. With a corpus index beside it, three of the four hashed files in that directory are byte-identical to the pinned cjson 1.7.15 release, so the component becomes pkg:generic/cjson@1.7.15 and carries a bomwerk:fingerprint property stating the count. local_patch.c is the fourth file and is not upstream, which is what makes the match partial: v1 reports 3 of 4 and names no verdict, since flagging a fork is T93. The index is generated by scripts/build_fingerprint_corpus.py --from-tree (see SOURCES.md), never hand-written, and is built from this tree's own bytes so no third-party content enters the repository. Read as a pair with nightmare-corpus, which pins the same directory WITHOUT an index: its third_party/cjson-prebuilt component carries no bomwerk:fingerprint property, which is the regression test for the option being off by default.
